description: This file defines the 'WorkDocsClient' class in the AWS SDK for PHP, specifically for interacting with the Amazon WorkDocs service. It includes method annotations for various API operations supported by the service, indicating both synchronous and asynchronous methods.

classes.name: WorkDocsClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with the Amazon WorkDocs service in AWS SDK PHP. It extends AwsClient and provides methods to perform operations such as creating folders, managing users, and handling document versions.
